jobs.description:
Director, Analyst – Manufacturing Operations Technology

Location: Remote US / North America

About the role:

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have research, market predictions, and best practices for world-leading organizations. A Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group. Utilizing research and analytical skills, a Director produces pragmatic and provocative research that clients use to drive key business outcomes.

They are a trusted source of advice, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support interactions, and Gartner conferences to address complex challenges and deliver actionable recommendations.

At a time when manufacturing organizations are rapidly adopting AI-driven and autonomous technologies, Gartner is seeking a Manufacturing Operations Technology Analyst focused on smart manufacturing technologies, including Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and next-generation capabilities such as AI and generative AI, agentic systems, digital twins, advanced automation, robotics, and cloud and edge computing.

This role will drive thought-leading research on tools, solutions, and technology ecosystems that address critical Supply Chain and Manufacturing Operations challenges. This research will be targeted to CSCOs and COOs, Heads of Manufacturing, Manufacturing Strategy, and Manufacturing Operations Technology Leaders within end-user organizations, as well as practice and product leaders within leading services and software providers.

What you will do:

  • Advise our business and technology clients on market landscape, vendor selection, and implementation to solve mission critical priorities, including reviewing software proposals.
  • Research, write, and advise on digital transformation and the changing vendor landscape for manufacturing solutions, new and defining emerging technology developments, ecosystems, architectures, and business models.
  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have research” content on digital transformation and the evolution of current Manufacturing Operations technologies and related use cases, including Magic Quadrants, Market Guides, Hype Cycles and/or Toolkits.
  • Develop forward-looking research and thought leadership that provides actionable approaches to accelerate client decision-making.
  • Diagnose root causes of client challenges and reframe strategies to unlock progress.
  • Develop and articulate clear research positions by synthesizing market trends, emerging technologies, and independent insights that shape Gartner’s research agenda.
  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice and insights through virtual and face-to-face interactions.
  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings
  • Support Research and Sales by acting as a voice of the market, contributing to content development and client engagement.
  • Provide high quality and timely research content peer review.
  • Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner research, methodology and strategy.
  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the research community.
  • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and Research & Advisory provide excellent service delivery.
  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members.
  • Drive ongoing client engagement with Gartner research and advisory interactions.

What you will need:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred
  • 10+ years of relevant field or industry experience
  • Significant experience in developing, managing, implementing and/or using manufacturing operations technologies and a robust understanding of key cross industry manufacturing processes with an emphasis on manufacturing operations management, manufacturing execution systems and IT/OT integration.
  • In-depth experience of MES and at least two to three of the following processes and the technologies that support them:
    • Manufacturing Operations
    • Production Management
    • Manufacturing Engineering
    • Operations Excellence / Continuous Improvement
    • Production automation
    • Production Logistics
  • Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills: ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables.
  • Excellent research, writing, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex concepts into clear, compelling insights.
  • Strong analytical skills: ability to synthesize data, apply frameworks, and defend conclusions
  • Strong business and financial acumen.
  • Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market.
  • Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team.
  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments.
  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is 148,000 USD - 175,500 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. Our talent acquisition team will provide the specific opportunity on our bonus or incentive programs to eligible candidates. We also offer market leading benefit programs including generous PTO, a 401k match up to $7,200 per year, the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount, and more.

The policy of Gartner is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.

jobs.title: Lehrkraft für Pflege
jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. Negentrix Holding ist ein Bildungsunternehmen mit der Mission, Menschen durch praxisorientierte Ausbildung und Unterstützung bei der Arbeitsmarktintegration in Deutschland zu begleiten.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Negentrix Holding ist ein Bildungsunternehmen mit der Mission, Menschen durch praxisorientierte Ausbildung und Unterstützung bei der Arbeitsmarktintegration in Deutschland zu begleiten.
Wir betreiben vier Schulen –MBI Akademie, IT Career Hub, DWW Akademie und Beam Institute of Technology–, in denen wir unsere Teilnehmer*innen für gefragte Berufe qualifizieren und sie vom Moment der Berufsorientierung bis zum ersten Job unterstützen.
Unsere Zielgruppe sind Menschen, für die Deutsch nicht die Muttersprache ist, für die Deutschland jedoch zu einem neuen Zuhause geworden ist. Wir wissen, wie wir ihnen helfen können, Teil der Gesellschaft zu werden und sich beruflich erfolgreich zu integrieren.
Wir helfen Menschen, von Grund auf in den Pflegeberuf einzusteigen, sich weiterzubilden, ausländische Diplome anerkennen zu lassen und sich auf die Arbeit im deutschen Gesundheitssystem vorzubereiten. Unsere Programme umfassen Schulungen für Pflegehelfer + Betreuungskraft, Behandlungspflege LG1/LG2 sowie die Vorbereitung auf die Kenntnisprüfung und fachspezifisches Deutsch für den medizinischen Bereich.
Wir arbeiten mit Teilnehmenden zusammen, die bereits in Deutschland leben oder nach Deutschland gezogen sind und eine Karriere in der Pflege aufbauen möchten. Die Ausbildung findet überwiegend online statt, wobei ein Teil der Praxis in Präsenz im Skill Lab und bei Partnern absolviert wird. Auf der Website der Akademie ist angegeben, dass die Programme bis zu 80 % Online-Format, Praxis im Skill Lab und Unterstützung der Studierenden auf Russisch beinhalten können.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine Fachkraft, die uns dabei unterstützt, die Qualität der Bildungsprogramme, die Unterrichtsmaterialien und die Vorbereitung der Studierenden auf die reale Arbeit im deutschen Pflegesystem weiterzuentwickeln.
Wir suchen eine/n Pflegepädagoge / Medizinpädagoge / Lehrkraft Pflege mit praktischer Erfahrung in der Pflege und pädagogischer Qualifikation.
Wir benötigen jemanden, der nicht nur Unterricht erteilen kann, sondern auch die Ausbildung methodisch aufbaut: Programme entwickelt, Lernmodule strukturiert sowie Materialien an das Niveau der Studierenden und die Anforderungen des deutschen Gesundheitssystems anpasst.
Diese Rolle könnte für Sie interessant sein, wenn Sie:
  • praktische Erfahrung in der Pflege haben;
  • bereits unterrichtet oder Mitarbeitende geschult haben;
  • in einem Bildungsumfeld arbeiten möchten;
  • wissen, wie man Wissen strukturiert und praktische Erfahrung in ein verständliches Curriculum umwandelt;
  • die Besonderheiten des deutschen Gesundheitssystems verstehen;
  • Menschen dabei helfen möchten, in den Beruf einzusteigen und in Deutschland beruflich zu wachsen.
Ihre Aufgaben:
  • an der Entwicklung und Aktualisierung der MBI Akademie-Programme mitwirken, einschließlich Modulen, Fallstudien und Tests;
  • Lerninhalte für erwachsene Studierende mit unterschiedlichen Vorkenntnissen anpassen;
  • Unterricht in Pflege- und medizinischen Fachbereichen erteilen sowie Studierende auf die Praxis in Deutschland vorbereiten;
  • an der Vorbereitung auf die Kenntnisprüfung mitwirken und Lernzielkontrollen durchführen;
  • Kenntnisse der Studierenden bewerten und qualitativ hochwertiges fachliches Feedback geben;
  • Theorie, Praxis und Prüfungsanforderungen im Lernprozess miteinander verknüpfen;
  • Programme für Pflegehelfer, Betreuungskräfte, Behandlungspflege LG1/LG2 und Anerkennung weiterentwickeln;
  • mit dem Akademieteam, Dozenten und Praxispartnern zusammenarbeiten;
  • den hohen Bildungsstandard der Programme sichern und kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln.

Requirements
  • abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Pflegefachkraft, Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger/in oder Altenpfleger/in;
  • Studium oder Weiterbildung im Bereich Pflegepädagogik, Medizinpädagogik oder Erwachsenenbildung;
  • Erfahrung in der Lehre, im Mentoring oder in der Praxisanleitung im Bereich Pflege;
  • Fähigkeit, Unterrichtsmaterialien eigenständig zu entwickeln und zu strukturieren;
  • fließende Deutschkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau, Russischkenntnisse von Vorteil;
  • Fähigkeit, komplexe medizinische Fachthemen einfach und verständlich zu erklären;
  • Bereitschaft, das Bildungsangebot aktiv mitzugestalten, statt nur vorgefertigte Lektionen zu halten.
Wünschenswert:
  • Erfahrung in einer Pflegeschule oder in medizinischen Bildungszentren;
  • Erfahrung in der Vorbereitung ausländischer Fachkräfte auf die Kenntnisprüfung und das Anerkennungsverfahren;
  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung modularer Lehrpläne und in der Abnahme praktischer Prüfungen;
  • Kompetenzen als Praxisanleiter/in sowie Erfahrung mit Online-Learning oder LMS;
  • Russischkenntnisse zur effektiven Betreuung eines Teils der Studierenden;
  • Erfahrung mit Programmen für Hilfskräfte (LG1/LG2, Betreuungskraft).

Benefits
  • Beschäftigung zwischen 20 und 40 Stunden pro Woche;
  • Honorar: 50 - 60€ pro ausgearbeitetem Unterrichtskonzept für den Experten.
  • Möglichkeit, vollständig remote von jedem Ort in Deutschland aus zu arbeiten;
  • die Vergütung wird individuell je nach Qualifikation, Erfahrung und Aufgabenbereich vereinbart;
  • Mitwirkung an der Entwicklung gefragter Bildungsprogramme im Pflegebereich in einem professionellen Team;
  • Möglichkeit, Kursinhalte und Ausbildungsqualität aktiv zu beeinflussen sowie den Bereich Weiterbildung auszubauen;
  • Raum für methodische Eigeninitiative innerhalb der Lehrprozesse.

At EverCommerce [Nasdaq: EVCM], we are on a mission to digitally transform the service economy with tailored, end-to-end SaaS solutions that simplify and empower the lives of our 745,000+ customers. As a leading service commerce platform, our modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals in the areas of Home & Field Services, Health Services, and Wellness industries.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:

We are looking for a Payments Support Associate to join our EverCommerce Payments Division, supporting our PaySimple product- a leading provider of embedded payment solutions for small and mid-sized businesses (SMBs). PaySimple empowers businesses to accept payments seamlessly, automate billing, manage transactions, and enhance financial security across online and mobile platforms.

If you thrive in a fast-paced, problem-solving environment, love helping businesses navigate payment processing challenges, and get satisfaction from turning complex issues into clear solutions, this role is for you. You’re energized by high-volume customer interactions, enjoy digging into transaction-related problems, and take pride in delivering exceptional service that makes a real impact on merchants and their businesses.

Responsibilities:

  • Deliver high-volume support via phone, email, and chat to SMBs, merchants, and clients using our payment processing solutions.
  • Proactively identify at-risk merchants by analyzing account activity, transaction trends, and support interactions; offer tailored solutions to prevent cancellations and improve retention.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve payment-related issues, including transaction failures, funding delays, chargebacks, fraud alerts, and account changes.
  • Guide businesses through onboarding, platform navigation, and advanced account features to help them maximize the value of our B2B payment processing solutions.
  • Support multiple types of merchant accounts, including direct software users, third-party partners, and integrated SaaS platforms.
  • Educate merchants on payment processing best practices, PCI compliance, and fraud prevention measures to enhance account security.
  • Identify and escalate complex cases related to payment disputes, risk assessment, and compliance concerns to the appropriate internal teams.
  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions in our CRM system.
  • Contribute to a merchant-first support strategy, ensuring businesses have a seamless, reliable, and transparent payment processing experience.
  • Stay updated on payment processing regulations, chargeback policies, and industry trends to better assist customers.

Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:

  • Previous experience in customer support, preferably in financial services, B2B payments, banking, or fintech is a plus, but not required.
  • Ability to effectively de-escalate calls and provide solutions that reduce churn and enhance customer satisfaction.
  • Comfortable working with CRM systems, payment gateways, and merchant account platforms.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical payment processing concepts in an accessible way.
  • Adaptability to fast-paced, high-volume environments while managing multiple tasks efficiently.
  • Ability to quickly identify, troubleshoot, and resolve payment-related issues.
  • Strong critical thinking and analytical skills with a focus on finding solutions.
  • Ability to handle sensitive financial information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Strong commitment to customer satisfaction and relationship-building.

Where: US Remote working Monday - Friday 7am to 4pm Mountain Time

The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States – if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.

jobs.excerpt: About MoznMOZN is a leading Enterprise AI company enabling organizations to make informed decisions in two critical domains: Financial Crime Prevention and Enterprise Knowledge Intelligence.
jobs.description:
About Mozn

MOZN is a leading Enterprise AI company enabling organizations to make informed decisions in two critical domains: Financial Crime Prevention and Enterprise Knowledge Intelligence.

We’re a diverse, collaborative team of innovators united by a shared purpose: to build AI that delivers tangible business value, builds trust, and empowers people and organizations with augmented intelligence. Our culture is built on the relentless pursuit of excellence and meaningful impact.

If you’re passionate about working alongside exceptional talent on world-class AI, and you want the autonomy and runway to do the best work of your career, join us in shaping the future of intelligent enterprises.

About the role

We're hiring an AI Senior SRE: someone who carries a normal SRE workload — on-call rotation, incident response, root cause analysis, hands-on Kubernetes/cloud work — and builds the agentic layer that automates that workload over time. You are not exempt from operating production. You're the person best placed to know what should be automated, because you're the one doing it. This role exists because most reliability toil (triage, root-causing, remediation, SLO tracking, onboarding checks) is repetitive and well-defined enough to hand to an LLM-based agent with the right guardrails. Your job is to do the on-call/ops work like any SRE, then turn what you learn into agents — identify the workflow, build the agent, and earn the trust to let it act with increasing autonomy.

What you'll do

  • Carry a normal on-call rotation and act as a hands-on responder: investigate, fix, and document incidents yourself, exactly like any SRE on the team — especially for workflows that don' t have an agent yet.
  • Go deep on application-level reliability, not just infrastructure: read and debug service code, understand business logic well enough to find the real root cause, and ship fixes or PRs directly into application repos when the fix belongs in the app, not the platform.
  • Design, build, and ship LLM-based agents (using tools like Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or Kimi K2/K3) that plug into our existing stack: Kubernetes, cloud APIs, Prometheus/Grafana/ELK/Datadog, PagerDuty/Slack.
  • Define the "tool" interface each agent needs — the specific APIs, scripts, and read/write actions — and build safe wrappers around them.
  • Set clear guardrails for every agent: what it may do autonomously vs. what it must propose for human approval, with a bias toward human-in-the-loop until an agent has earned trust.
  • Own agent evaluation — define what "correct" and "safe" look like per agent, and build test/backtest suites against real historical incidents.
  • Continuously tune prompts, context, and tool schemas as an agent' s scope grows.
  • Partner with the SRE/platform team to find good agent candidates: repetitive, well-scoped, auditable workflows.
  • Report on agent impact — MTTD/MTTR/MTTX movement, false positive/negative rates, and engineer-hours of toil removed.
  • Keep a security- and compliance-first posture: audit trails for every autonomous action, least-privilege access to production, and alignment with Saudi data residency/regulatory requirements.

Requirements

  • 3+ years building production software with LLMs — agentic workflows, tool/function calling, multi-step planning, RAG — not just personal use of a chat assistant.
  • Hands-on experience shipping real work with an agentic coding tool such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or Kimi K2/K3.
  • Strong Python (or similar) for building agent tooling, API wrappers, and orchestration.
  • Real, hands-on SRE experience: comfortable being a primary on-call responder, running incident response, and doing root cause analysis under pressure — not just familiar with the concepts.
  • Application-level debugging skill, not just infra: able to read a service' s codebase, trace a failure back to the actual line/logic causing it, and ship a fix yourself — SRE work here isn' t limited to restarting pods or scaling nodes.
  • Solid hands-on Kubernetes and cloud provider experience (AWS/GCP/OCI/Azure) and fluency with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK) — both as an operator and as integration points for agents.
  • Understands guardrails for autonomous systems: permissioning, approval gates, rollback paths, auditability.
  • Can build trust with technical stakeholders — every agent starts with limited autonomy and has to earn more.

Nice to have

  • Experience in Saudi Arabia / MENA, ideally consulting across public or private sector clients.
  • Familiarity with Terraform/Ansible, Docker, VM/on-prem setups — useful context for the agents you' ll build, not the core job.
  • Experience building eval/backtest harnesses for LLM agents against historical incident data.
  • Background in ML engineering, LLMOps, or platform engineering.

Benefits

  • You will be at the forefront of an exciting time for the Middle East, joining a high-growth rocket-ship in an exciting space
  • You will be given a lot of responsibility and trust. We believe that the best results come when the people responsible for a function are given the freedom to do what they think is best
  • The fundamentals will be taken care of: competitive compensation, top-tier health insurance, and an enabling culture so that you can focus on what you do best
  • You will enjoy a fun and dynamic workplace working alongside some of the greatest minds in AI
  • We believe strength lies in difference, embracing all for who they are and empowered to be the best version of themselves

jobs.description:
Remote | Micro-equity or volunteer basis | Early-stage AI/Education Startup

Maxibook is an early-stage AI startup rethinking how scientific knowledge is delivered, organized, and personalized.

We are building an Adaptive Knowledge System powered by dynamic knowledge maps and LLM-driven adaptive content, with an MVP expected by Q1 2026.

Our initial focus is on universities, research institutions, and publicly funded initiatives, with future expansion into the corporate HR sector (onboarding, continuous training, skill-gap reduction).

We are entering the fundraising phase and looking for passionate contributors who want to help us build the foundations of a global platform.

Tasks

Scientific Language & AI Adaptation Contributor(Korean / Japanese / Arabic)

We are looking for contributors who can help us adapt English scientific content to languages with fundamentally different writing systems, grammar, and conceptual structures, working in close collaboration with AI tools.

This is not a translation role.

At Maxibook, content is generated and adapted through AI. Our challenge is understanding how meaning, structure, tone, and scientific precision change when moving from English to languages such as Korean, Japanese, or Arabic — where:

  • sentence construction follows different logical flows
  • terminology is built differently
  • writing conventions for science and education differ
  • correctness cannot be validated by English speakers alone

What you will actually do

  • Help us understand how scientific and educational language works in your language
  • Explain how concepts are normally structured, introduced, and developed in written form
  • Guide the correct use of AI for linguistic adaptation, not just literal translation
  • Review and validate AI-generated outputs to ensure they are:
  • conceptually accurate
  • natural and credible in your language
  • appropriate for scientific and academic contexts
  • Identify when an AI translation is formally correct but conceptually or stylistically wrong
  • Suggest tools, workflows, or strategies to reliably adapt English content using AI

This role is about making AI-generated knowledge reliable in languages we do not personally speak.

Who this is for

  • Native or near-native speakers of Korean, Japanese, or Arabic
  • People who deeply understand written language conventions, especially for science or education
  • Translators, researchers, educators, developers, or AI-literate contributors
  • Anyone able to explain how and why things are written the way they are in their language

You don’t need to translate everything manually.

You need to help us build confidence in AI-driven adaptation.

Why this role matters

Simply asking an AI to “translate to Japanese or Arabic” is not enough.

Without linguistic insight, we cannot verify correctness, clarity, or credibility.

Your contribution helps Maxibook:

  • avoid superficial or misleading translations
  • design better multilingual AI workflows
  • deliver scientific knowledge that actually works across languages and cultures

You will help shape how global scientific knowledge is adapted, not just translated.

Bring your enthusiasm, skills, and curiosity into the project. Every contribution matters — you’ll help lay the bricks of a system that could redefine the future of education.

Requirements

We welcome both experienced professionals and early-career talents — what matters most is your genuine interest in AI, education, and the desire to learn and grow with the project.

  • Genuine interest in AI, education, or digital innovation
  • Willingness to commit a few hours per week (flexible, milestone-based)
  • Desire to learn, experiment, and grow together with the project
  • No need to leave your current job or studies — join us part-time while we bootstrap funding

Benefits

We are early-stage, and contributions are currently on a voluntary and/or micro-equity basis, depending on role, commitment, and duration.

Once funding is secured, we are committed to recognizing and formalizing the contributions of those who supported Maxibook from the very beginning.

It’s about building something that truly matters.

  • Join an international, visionary project from the ground up
  • Gain the opportunity for micro-equity recognition and potential future integration into the founding core
  • Be part of a team pushing the boundaries of AI in education
  • Enjoy visibility, learning, and the excitement of shaping a startup before its official launch

Simply put: we’re working hard to secure funding — in the meantime, we’re building together. Your contribution today could become your long-term place in Maxibook tomorrow.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Maxibook OÜ welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or marital status. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. All personal data shared will be processed with confidentiality and in compliance with privacy standards.

If you are looking for more than a side project — if you want to leave a mark in how the world learns and outreach science — this is your moment.

Apply now to join Maxibook as a contributor. Let’s build together.

jobs.excerpt: About MenloMenlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it.
jobs.description:
About Menlo

Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role

This is our first marketing hire and a full-stack marketing role with full strategic ownership of Menlo's presence and pipeline in APAC. You will set the direction and execute it, covering brand, content, demand generation, community, and go-to-market across our product portfolio: Asimov and the Menlo Platform. You will work closely with the founders and senior leadership across Singapore and Ho Chi Minh City, owning Menlo's APAC positioning and go-to-market strategy. This is an individual contributor role today with genuine strategic scope. You will define what marketing at Menlo looks like in Asia, build it from the ground up, and shape the team that grows around it.

What You Will Do

  • Set and own Menlo's APAC marketing strategy across brand, content, demand generation, community, and go-to-market

  • Define positioning and messaging for Asimov and the Menlo Platform for APAC audiences: developers, enterprise buyers, researchers, and the broader AI and robotics ecosystem

  • Build and grow Menlo's presence across LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Discord, Reddit, and APAC developer communities

  • Produce and manage content across formats: written, video, short-form, long-form, technical and non-technical

  • Drive demand generation and lead capture for the commercial products, owning the APAC funnel from awareness to conversion

  • Build relationships with APAC press, analysts, research labs, enterprise buyers, and developer communities

  • Plan and execute presence at APAC industry events: conferences, meetups, and developer gatherings in the AI, robotics, and deep tech space

  • Set up marketing automation tooling to make outreach and community management scalable across markets and time zones

  • Work cross-functionally with the Singapore and HCMC teams to surface what is worth telling the APAC market about, and package it for that audience

What You Will Bring

  • 5 or more years in marketing at a B2B SaaS or technical product company in the APAC market, with at least one experience owning the marketing function end-to-end: strategy, execution, and results

  • Proven ability to define positioning and messaging for a technical product, not just run campaigns

  • Demonstrated track record of growing an audience, community, or pipeline from an early stage in APAC

  • Strong writing: you can produce a sharp LinkedIn post, a cold email, a technical explainer, and a brand narrative without needing multiple rounds of edits

  • Comfortable with video: you have produced or closely directed video content before, whether short-form social or long-form technical

  • Data-driven instincts: you set goals, track them, and change course when something is not working

  • A genuine network in the APAC AI, robotics, or deep tech ecosystem: you know who to call

Nice to Have

  • Experience marketing developer tools, open-source products, or AI infrastructure

  • Background in robotics, deep tech, or hardware-adjacent industries

  • Experience building developer relations or DevRel-adjacent programs

  • Prior experience working with or for an international company with a distributed team

  • Familiarity with community platforms: Discord, Reddit, Discourse, or similar

Why Join Menlo

Menlo is building the robot labor force of tomorrow, at the frontier of embodied AI and humanoid robotics, and we are serious about the APAC market. As our first marketing hire, you will have full strategic ownership of how the Asian AI and robotics ecosystem sees us, from positioning and messaging to developer community to enterprise pipeline. A direct line to the founders, real creative and strategic ownership, and the chance to define the marketing function of one of the most ambitious deep tech labs in the world. The team is lean, the work is consequential, and the timing is right.

A Note on AI

You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

Business Development Representative (BDR) – B2B SaaS, Outbound Sales & Lead Generation

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: Colombia, Mexico, Brazil
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Business Development Representative (BDR) to generate qualified opportunities and build a consistent B2B sales pipeline.

This is a quota-carrying, execution-focused sales role for someone who is comfortable prospecting every day, speaking with decision-makers, qualifying inbound opportunities, and turning cold outreach into booked meetings.

You’ll own both inbound lead qualification and outbound prospecting, using modern sales tools and multi-channel outreach across phone, email, and LinkedIn.

Your primary objective is simple: create qualified pipeline that turns into revenue.

If you have experience as an SDR or BDR, are confident cold calling U.S.-based prospects, and enjoy working toward measurable targets, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Outbound Prospecting & Lead Generation

Build and execute targeted outbound campaigns using:

  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • Apollo
  • ZoomInfo
  • Email
  • Cold calling
  • LinkedIn outreach

You’ll:

  • Research target accounts and decision-makers.
  • Build high-quality prospect lists.
  • Execute personalized multi-channel outreach sequences.
  • Cold call prospective customers.
  • Write compelling cold emails and LinkedIn messages.
  • Test messaging, sequences, and outreach strategies.
  • Follow up consistently with prospects.
  • Generate qualified meetings for Account Executives.

Inbound Lead Qualification

Respond quickly to inbound leads generated through:

  • Marketing campaigns
  • Website inquiries
  • Events
  • Other demand-generation channels

Conduct discovery and qualification conversations to understand:

  • Business needs
  • Pain points
  • Budget
  • Decision-making authority
  • Buying process
  • Timeline

Determine whether opportunities meet qualification criteria and move qualified prospects into the sales pipeline.

Discovery Calls & Meeting Booking

Conduct professional conversations with B2B prospects and decision-makers.

You’ll:

  • Ask effective discovery questions.
  • Identify business challenges and buying intent.
  • Understand prospect needs before positioning next steps.
  • Handle common objections confidently.
  • Qualify opportunities accurately.
  • Schedule qualified meetings and demos for Account Executives.
  • Provide clear handoff notes so AEs enter meetings with the right context.

CRM & Pipeline Management

Maintain accurate sales records using platforms such as:

  • Salesforce
  • HubSpot
  • Zoho CRM

Track:

  • Prospect activity
  • Calls
  • Emails
  • Qualification notes
  • Follow-ups
  • Opportunity stages
  • Meetings booked

Maintain strong CRM hygiene so the sales team has reliable visibility into pipeline activity and next steps.

Lead Nurturing & Follow-Up

Not every prospect will be ready to buy immediately.

You’ll:

  • Nurture early-stage opportunities.
  • Maintain structured follow-up cadences.
  • Re-engage prospects at the right time.
  • Track next steps and buying signals.
  • Ensure qualified prospects don’t disappear because of missed follow-ups.

Sales Collaboration & Optimization

Work closely with Account Executives and sales leadership on:

  • Pipeline reviews
  • Target account strategy
  • Qualification criteria
  • Prospect feedback
  • Objection patterns
  • Outreach messaging

Share insights from prospect conversations to help improve targeting and sales execution.

Continuously evaluate:

  • Reply rates
  • Connect rates
  • Meetings booked
  • Qualification rates
  • Lead-to-opportunity conversion
  • Pipeline generated

Use performance data to improve your outreach approach.

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

  • 2+ years of experience as a BDR, SDR, Inside Sales Representative, or similar B2B sales professional.
  • Proven track record of:
    • Meeting or exceeding quota
    • Booking qualified meetings
    • Generating sales pipeline
  • Hands-on outbound prospecting experience.
  • Confidence with:
    • Cold calling
    • Cold email
    • LinkedIn prospecting
  • Experience with prospecting tools such as:
    • Apollo
    • ZoomInfo
    • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • Experience using CRM platforms such as:
    • Salesforce
    • HubSpot
    • Zoho CRM
  • Strong discovery and lead qualification skills.
  • Excellent spoken and written English.
  • Comfortable communicating with U.S.-based prospects and decision-makers.
  • Highly organized with strong follow-through.
  • Metrics-driven and comfortable working toward activity and pipeline targets.
  • Resilient and comfortable handling rejection.
  • Ability to work remotely during U.S. business hours.
  • Based in Colombia, Mexico, or Brazil.

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • B2B SaaS sales experience.
  • Technology or professional services sales experience.
  • Experience running structured outbound campaigns.
  • Familiarity with sales methodologies such as:
    • SPIN
    • MEDDIC
    • Challenger
  • Experience working with Account Executives in a structured SDR/BDR organization.
  • Experience selling into U.S. businesses.
  • Experience prospecting senior decision-makers.
  • Familiarity with sales engagement and sequencing tools.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Are comfortable picking up the phone and starting conversations.
  • Know how to personalize outreach without sacrificing volume.
  • Understand the difference between booking meetings and booking qualified meetings.
  • Ask thoughtful discovery questions rather than immediately pitching.
  • Follow up consistently without needing reminders.
  • Stay motivated despite rejection.
  • Think in terms of pipeline and revenue, not activity alone.
  • Keep your CRM clean and accurate.
  • Take ownership of your numbers.
  • Constantly test ways to improve your conversion rates.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Reviewing new inbound leads and responding quickly.
  • Researching target accounts and decision-makers.
  • Building prospect lists using Apollo, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
  • Making outbound cold calls.
  • Sending personalized cold emails and LinkedIn messages.
  • Running discovery and qualification calls.
  • Following up with warm and previously contacted prospects.
  • Booking qualified meetings for Account Executives.
  • Updating CRM records and next steps.
  • Reviewing sequence performance and response rates.
  • Participating in pipeline reviews with the sales team.
  • Testing new messaging or prospecting approaches.

In short: you create qualified sales opportunities by combining disciplined prospecting, strong communication, effective qualification, and persistent follow-up.

Key Metrics for Success

  • 10–15 discovery calls per week
  • 8–12 qualified opportunities per month
  • Qualified meetings booked
  • Lead-to-opportunity conversion rate
  • Outbound response and connection rates
  • Daily and weekly prospecting activity
  • Pipeline generated
  • Meeting quality and AE acceptance rate
  • Consistency of prospect follow-up
  • 100% CRM data accuracy

Spark Hire Intro Video

As part of the application process, you’ll be asked to complete a short Spark Hire intro video.

We’d like to hear about:

  • Your experience as an SDR, BDR, or inside sales professional.
  • The types of B2B products or services you have sold.
  • Your experience selling into the U.S. market.
  • Your experience with cold calling, cold email, and LinkedIn prospecting.
  • How many outbound calls or touches you typically complete in a day or week.
  • Your average number of qualified meetings booked per month.
  • Your previous quota and how consistently you achieved it.
  • A specific example of an outbound opportunity you generated that ultimately contributed to revenue.
  • How you research and personalize outreach to a new prospect.
  • How you handle a prospect who says, “I’m not interested.”
  • How you determine whether a lead is genuinely qualified before booking a meeting for an Account Executive.
  • Your approach to following up when a prospect initially responds but then goes quiet.
  • Your experience with Apollo, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
  • Which CRM platforms you have used and how you maintain accurate pipeline records.
  • The prospecting or sales metrics you monitor most closely and why.

Keep your answers clear, concise, and specific. Wherever possible, include measurable results such as quota attainment, meetings booked, conversion rates, pipeline generated, or revenue influenced.

Completion of the Spark Hire intro video is required for your application to be considered.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on pipeline and company revenue.
  • Ownership across inbound and outbound lead generation.
  • Hands-on experience with modern B2B sales tools.
  • Clear, measurable performance expectations.
  • Opportunity to work with U.S.-based prospects and businesses.
  • Fully remote position.
  • High-growth sales environment.
  • Strong career progression into:
    • Senior BDR
    • Account Executive
    • Business Development Manager
    • Sales Development Lead

Interview Process

  • Application Review
  • Spark Hire Intro Video
  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Recruiter Interview
  • Client Interview
  • Offer

Apply Now

If you have strong BDR/SDR experience, are confident with cold calling, outbound prospecting, lead qualification, and CRM management, and have a track record of generating qualified B2B opportunities, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and complete the required Spark Hire intro video to move forward.

Job Requisition ID #


26WD95293

Job Description for Senior Platform Engineer

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Platform Developer to join the Platform Services and Emerging Technology organization within the Developer Enablement (DevRel) group.

Our mission is to enable developers with the tools, platforms, and support needed to build, test, and deploy high-quality applications at scale using Autodesk developer platforms (e.g., CloudOS, Beacon). The DevRel team drives knowledge sharing, collaboration, and developer empowerment across internal and external engineering teams.

In this role, you will act as a senior-level technical leader for developer enablement and onboarding platforms across Americas, Canada, and EMEA. You will design and evolve systems that improve developer productivity, onboarding velocity, and platform reliability.

This role requires strong hands-on expertise in cloud platform engineering, AI/ML systems, and agentic AI workflows, particularly leveraging LLM-based automation to improve onboarding, troubleshooting, and developer self-service experiences.

You will design and operate cloud-native applications, CI/CD systems, and Infrastructure-as-Code automation using technologies such as Terraform, Helm, and Kubernetes.

You will also leverage AI/ML and agentic AI systems to introduce intelligent automation across developer onboarding, troubleshooting, and platform self-service workflows, enabling a next-generation developer enablement experience.

You will report to a Senior Engineering Manager.

Responsibilities

  • Own and drive the architecture and evolution of developer onboarding and enablement platforms
  • Standardize and improve service deployment processes across application teams
  • Accelerate onboarding and deployment timelines through scalable platform automation
  • Design and implement cloud-native automation to reduce manual effort across onboarding workflows
  • Build and support developer enablement tooling and internal platform services
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance and support for developers using internal platforms
  • Troubleshoot complex platform and integration issues across distributed systems
  • Collaborate with application and platform teams to ensure evolving developer needs are met
  • Design and implement AI/ML and agentic AI solutions to automate onboarding, enhance troubleshooting, and improve developer self-service capabilities
  • Apply AI-driven automation to improve platform efficiency, reliability, and developer experience at scale
  • Define and contribute to technical roadmap planning for platform modernization and automation initiatives
  • Create and maintain high-quality technical documentation, runbooks, and enablement materials
  • Stay current with emerging technologies in cloud platforms, AI/ML, and agentic AI systems

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related field
  • 8+ years of experience building scalable cloud-native applications using Python, Node.js, or similar frameworks
  • 8+ years of experience in cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
  • 8+ years of experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines and SDLC automation (Jenkins, CloudBees, Spinnaker, etc.)
  • 8+ years of experience with Infrastructure-as-Code and platform automation tools (Terraform, Helm, Ansible, etc.)
  • Experience with containerized and distributed systems using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking, observability, and distributed system design
  • Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and incident resolution skills
  • Experience creating operational documentation (runbooks, engineering guides, system design docs)
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills across engineering teams
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying production AI/ML systems
  • Experience with agentic AI systems or LLM-based automation workflows (tool use, orchestration, autonomous agents)
  • Proven ability to operate at a Senior Engineer level, combining hands-on execution with architecture ownership and technical leadership

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building AI-powered developer tools or platform automation systems
  • Experience with AWS AI/ML services such as Bedrock or equivalent LLM platforms
  • Experience designing agent-based workflows for automation or developer productivity
  • Experience building large-scale distributed systems in production environments
  • Strong background in DevOps, platform engineering, and infrastructure scalability
  • Experience with event-driven and microservices architectures
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and modern CI/CD practices
  • Demonstrated experience improving developer experience (DevEx) at scale

The Ideal Candidate

  • You are a senior-level cloud platform engineer who thrives in building scalable systems that improve developer productivity
  • You have deep hands-on experience in AI/ML and production-grade agentic AI systems
  • You have owned architecture for complex distributed platforms and driven technical direction across teams
  • You are equally comfortable designing systems and implementing critical components
  • You excel at building automation that reduces friction and improves developer experience
  • You have a strong track record of delivering platform-level impact in large-scale engineering organizations
  • You are motivated by solving complex infrastructure and onboarding challenges at scale

Learn More


About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.


We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.


When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!


Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For Ireland based roles, we expect a starting base salary between 71,000 EUR and 104,500 EUR. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range.   • Create and review software testing defect, progress, and summary reports

Qualifications of this Role:

  • Post-secondary education in Computer Science or Software Engineering

  • Experience with web servers such as Apache HTTP Server or NGINX

  • Experience with version control software such as Git or Perforce

  • Experience with API testing of RESTful and SOAP-based web services using tools like Postman, SoapUI, or other API testing frameworks.

  • Experience with build tools such as Maven or Ant or Gradle

  • Experience with continuous integration tools such as Jenkins or TeamCity

  • Detailed knowledge of all phases in the Software Testing Lifecycle

  • Experience designing and executing test suites for unit, integration, system, and acceptance test levels.

  • Experience working with a variety of software development languages (mainly java programming)

  • Familiarity with Typescript as a language (use for Playwright)

  • Familiarity with relational and non-relational database design

  • Excellent presentation skills with the ability to communicate at all levels of an organization.

We are looking for a qualified professional with strong technical proficiency in automation tools and a strategic approach to quality assurance. We are looking for a Freelance Project Manager to join our team and work across key accounts – bringing with them extensive experience in delivering varied types of program deliverables and content for distribution across digital and social, with an enthusiasm to work in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Taking ownership of projects and see them through to completion
  • Managing work across various channels, including social and editorial content, influencer work, events, video etc.
  • Creating timelines, booking and managing resources and ensuring that agency resources are used efficiently
  • Scoping jobs and writing statements of work
  • Managing budgets and reconciling each phase of the job
  • Ensuring all work is signed off at the right stages, by the right people; both internal sign-off, and client approvals
  • Ensure that all project team members also complete their timesheets in a timely fashion, ensuring accurate project actuals
  • Track account health. This includes monitoring project progress, burn rate, budget management, third party and freelance team management and developing plans to course correct the team as needed.

REQUIREMENTS FOR THIS ROLE

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, advertising, communications, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in project management or a related field, with a focus on operations, team management and project planning.
  • Experience with a wide variety of marketing and content deliverable types
  • Familiar with agency turn-around times and ways of working, good understanding of the dynamics of agency processes, and enjoy the pace and challenges this brings
  • Proactive and good at foreseeing problems, with the ability to mitigate issues as soon as they are identified, propose creative solutions, and know when to escalate issues
  • Detail oriented and takes responsibility for fulfilling all components of the project/retainer deliverables
  • Confident and positive with a ‘can-do’ attitude
  • Extremely strong communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Organized with good attention to detail
  • Strong understanding and experience in managing project financials
  • Highly proficient with Google Suite (Gmail, Doc, Slides, Sheets, Drive, Meet, Chat, Gemini) and Slack. Baseline knowledge of Asana and other PM and A.I. tools and functions. Added plus: Knowledge of Workbook

BMC is also committed to our employees, who are a very important piece to who we are. jobs.description:
Video Editor – Remote

Video Editing | Motion Graphics | Social Media Content | Brand Storytelling

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (Flexible to support deadlines and campaign launches)

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re hiring on behalf of one of our clients for a Video Editor to create engaging, high-quality video content across social media, marketing campaigns, training materials, and branded content.

This is more than a traditional editing role. You’ll transform raw footage into polished, platform-optimized videos that strengthen brand awareness, improve engagement, and support business growth.

Working closely with marketing and creative teams, you’ll produce everything from short-form social videos and paid advertising creatives to explainer videos, educational content, and long-form productions.

If you have a strong eye for storytelling, pacing, audience retention, and visual quality—and enjoy bringing ideas to life through video—this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Video Editing & Storytelling

  • Edit raw footage into polished videos for:
    • Social media
    • Marketing campaigns
    • Websites
    • Internal training
    • Branded content
  • Create compelling stories through:
    • Pacing
    • Sequencing
    • Transitions
    • Visual flow
  • Produce engaging short-form and long-form videos.
  • Ensure every edit aligns with brand guidelines and campaign objectives.
  • Deliver clean, professional content with exceptional attention to detail.

Motion Graphics & Visual Branding

  • Add:
    • Titles
    • Captions
    • Lower thirds
    • Callouts
    • Logos
    • Motion graphics
  • Create simple animations and branded visual elements.
  • Maintain consistency across all video deliverables.
  • Elevate content through modern editing techniques and creative enhancements.

Audio Editing & Color Correction

  • Synchronize audio and video accurately.
  • Improve sound quality through:
    • Noise reduction
    • Audio balancing
    • Sound mastering
  • Add licensed music and sound effects.
  • Perform color correction and color grading to deliver polished final products.

Multi-Platform Video Production

  • Export videos optimized for:
    • YouTube
    • TikTok
    • Instagram
    • LinkedIn
    • Facebook
    • Company websites
  • Deliver multiple aspect ratios and platform-specific formats.
  • Optimize compression while maintaining high visual quality.
  • Ensure every video is publishing-ready and aligned with platform best practices.

Collaboration & Workflow Management

  • Collaborate with:
    • Marketing teams
    • Creative leads
    • Internal stakeholders
  • Manage feedback and revision cycles efficiently.
  • Maintain organized project files, raw footage, assets, and archives.
  • Utilize collaboration platforms such as:
    • Google Drive
    • Dropbox
    • Similar project management tools

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 2+ years of professional video editing experience.
  • Proficiency with at least one of:
    • Adobe Premiere Pro
    • DaVinci Resolve
    • Final Cut Pro
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Storytelling
    • Video pacing
    • Audio editing
    • Color correction
  • Experience exporting content for social media and web platforms.
  • Strong project organization and file management skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and time management.
  • Reliable high-speed internet and professional remote workspace.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with:
    • Adobe After Effects
    • Motion graphics
    • Animation
  • Experience editing:
    • Paid advertisements
    • UGC content
    • Performance marketing creatives
  • Understanding of:
    • Watch time
    • Engagement metrics
    • Click-through rate (CTR)
  • Experience in:
    • SaaS
    • E-commerce
    • Agencies
    • Media companies
    • Content-driven businesses
  • Familiarity with social-first editing styles for:
    • TikTok
    • Instagram Reels
    • YouTube Shorts

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Creative storyteller with a strong visual eye.
  • Excellent understanding of audience engagement and retention.
  • Highly organized and capable of managing multiple editing projects.
  • Comfortable receiving and implementing feedback.
  • Passionate about creating high-performing content.
  • Able to balance speed, quality, and consistency under deadlines.
  • Strong attention to detail and brand consistency.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review raw footage and organize project assets.
  • Edit videos for social media, campaigns, training, and branded content.
  • Add captions, graphics, transitions, music, and visual effects.
  • Perform audio cleanup and color grading.
  • Export multiple platform-specific versions.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders through review cycles.
  • Maintain organized project files and documentation.

In short: You transform raw footage into engaging, high-quality video content that strengthens brand storytelling, supports marketing campaigns, and drives audience engagement.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • On-time delivery of video projects
  • High editing quality with minimal revision rounds
  • Strong audience engagement and video performance
  • Consistent brand alignment across all content
  • Organized project files and asset management
  • Positive stakeholder feedback on creativity, quality, and turnaround time

Why Join Us?

  • Work on a diverse range of creative marketing projects.
  • Collaborate closely with marketing and leadership teams.
  • Opportunity to produce content that directly impacts brand growth and audience engagement.
  • Fully remote work environment with creative ownership.
  • Exposure to modern video production tools and content strategies.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Video Editor
    • Motion Graphics Designer
    • Creative Lead
    • Multimedia Producer
    • Creative Director

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Portfolio Review & Practical Editing Task
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re a creative video editor who enjoys transforming ideas into engaging visual stories, thrives in fast-paced environments, and takes pride in delivering polished, high-quality content, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help create compelling videos that drive engagement, strengthen brands, and support business growth.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Account Executive
jobs.excerpt: Senior Account Executive – Enterprise B2B Sales & High-Ticket DealsPosition Type: Full-Time, Contract, Remote Working Hours: U.
jobs.description:
Senior Account Executive – Enterprise B2B Sales & High-Ticket Deals

Position Type: Full-Time, Contract, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Eastern Time (EST)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Senior Account Executive to own the full B2B sales cycle and close complex, high-value deals with senior decision-makers.

This is a true full-cycle sales role — not a position focused solely on working inbound leads.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Building and maintaining your own pipeline
  • Prospecting and engaging senior decision-makers
  • Running discovery calls and product demonstrations
  • Managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
  • Negotiating and closing high-ticket B2B deals
  • Owning forecasting and revenue targets

If you have a proven track record in enterprise or mid-market B2B sales, consistently hit quota, and are comfortable selling directly to C-suite executives, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Full-Cycle B2B Sales

Own the entire sales process from first contact through signed agreement:

  • Prospecting
  • Qualification
  • Discovery
  • Product demonstrations
  • Proposal development
  • Negotiation
  • Closing

Build relationships with prospective customers while maintaining momentum throughout complex buying cycles.

Manage multiple high-value opportunities simultaneously and take full ownership of moving qualified deals toward close.

Pipeline Generation & Management

  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities.
  • Generate new business through proactive prospecting and follow-up.
  • Identify target accounts and relevant decision-makers.
  • Maintain disciplined follow-up across longer sales cycles.
  • Track opportunities, activities, next steps, and deal progression in Pipedrive or similar CRM platforms.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline visibility and forecasting.

Enterprise & Executive-Level Selling

Engage directly with:

  • C-suite executives
  • Business owners
  • Vice Presidents
  • Directors
  • Department leaders
  • Other key decision-makers and stakeholders

Understand business challenges, strategic priorities, buying motivations, and decision criteria.

Build credibility through consultative, value-driven conversations rather than transactional selling.

Complex Deal Management

  • Navigate multi-stakeholder buying processes.
  • Identify champions, decision-makers, influencers, and potential blockers.
  • Manage longer sales cycles and multiple approval stages.
  • Coordinate internal and external stakeholders throughout the deal.
  • Maintain momentum through procurement, negotiation, and final approval.
  • Develop clear strategies for advancing stalled or complex opportunities.

Discovery, Demonstrations & Value Selling

  • Run structured discovery calls to uncover business needs, pain points, priorities, and buying criteria.
  • Deliver compelling product demonstrations and sales presentations.
  • Tailor presentations to the prospect’s specific business objectives.
  • Clearly communicate ROI, business impact, and strategic value.
  • Position solutions as investments tied to measurable outcomes rather than simply products or tools.

Negotiation & Closing

  • Lead pricing and commercial conversations confidently.
  • Handle objections professionally and strategically.
  • Negotiate agreements while protecting deal value.
  • Identify and address barriers preventing prospects from moving forward.
  • Drive opportunities toward clear decisions and signed agreements.
  • Maintain strong relationships throughout the closing process.

Account Strategy & Revenue Growth

  • Develop account-level strategies for priority opportunities.
  • Identify expansion and repeat-business opportunities.
  • Understand target markets and buying patterns.
  • Prioritize opportunities based on value, probability, and strategic importance.
  • Take full ownership of individual revenue performance.

Forecasting & CRM Discipline

Maintain accurate CRM records covering:

  • Deal stage
  • Opportunity value
  • Next steps
  • Decision-makers
  • Expected close dates
  • Risks and blockers
  • Forecast probability

Provide reliable revenue forecasts and pipeline updates to leadership.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with:

  • Marketing
  • Product
  • Operations
  • Leadership

Coordinate internal resources to strengthen proposals, presentations, and deal strategy.

Share prospect feedback and market insights to improve messaging, positioning, and the overall sales process.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Positioning

  • Stay informed on competitors, market trends, and customer priorities.
  • Understand competitive alternatives prospects may be evaluating.
  • Incorporate relevant market insights into sales conversations.
  • Position the company effectively in competitive opportunities.
  • Share recurring market intelligence with internal stakeholders.

Required Experience & Skills

Non-Negotiables

  • 6+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally within enterprise or mid-market environments.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas.
  • Demonstrated experience closing high-value B2B deals.
  • Strong experience owning the full sales cycle from prospecting through close.
  • Experience selling directly to executives and senior decision-makers.
  • Strong understanding of complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Experience building and managing your own pipeline.
  • Strong CRM experience with Pipedrive or similar platforms.
  • Excellent discovery, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership in a remote environment.
  • Availability to work U.S. Eastern Time hours.

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • SaaS sales
  • Professional services sales
  • High-growth startup experience
  • Enterprise account management
  • 60–180+ day sales cycles
  • Multi-stakeholder enterprise deals
  • Consultative or solution-based selling
  • Account expansion and upselling
  • Experience with Zoom and Google Workspace
  • Familiarity with structured sales methodologies

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Have consistently closed meaningful B2B revenue.
  • Are comfortable speaking with C-suite executives and business leaders.
  • Can create pipeline instead of relying entirely on inbound opportunities.
  • Know how to run discovery conversations that uncover real business needs.
  • Understand how to sell value and ROI rather than features.
  • Can navigate complex deals involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Are disciplined with CRM management and forecasting.
  • Know when to push a deal forward and when to uncover additional information.
  • Take ownership of your quota and revenue outcomes.
  • Thrive in performance-driven environments with significant autonomy.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

A Senior Account Executive’s day may include:

  • Prospecting into high-value target accounts.
  • Following up with active opportunities.
  • Running discovery calls with executives and senior stakeholders.
  • Delivering tailored demos and presentations.
  • Preparing proposals and business cases.
  • Handling objections and negotiating commercial terms.
  • Developing strategies for complex or stalled opportunities.
  • Collaborating internally on priority deals.
  • Updating Pipedrive and reviewing pipeline health.
  • Forecasting expected revenue and upcoming closes.
  • Researching target accounts, competitors, and market developments.

In short: you build pipeline, manage complex B2B opportunities, and turn qualified prospects into closed revenue.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Monthly and quarterly revenue closed
  • Quota attainment
  • Qualified pipeline generated
  • Pipeline coverage
  • Opportunity-to-close conversion rate
  • Win rate
  • Average deal size
  • Sales cycle length and deal velocity
  • Forecast accuracy
  • CRM and pipeline accuracy

Why This Role Stands Out

  • True ownership of the complete B2B sales cycle.
  • Opportunity to close complex, high-value deals.
  • Direct interaction with executives and senior decision-makers.
  • High earning potential tied to individual performance.
  • Significant autonomy and ownership over your pipeline.
  • Direct impact on company revenue and growth.
  • Fully remote environment aligned with EST hours.
  • Opportunity to grow into:
    • Enterprise Account Executive
    • Strategic Account Executive
    • Sales Manager
    • Sales Director
    • Revenue Leadership

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Video Interview
  • Final Interview with Leadership
  • Background Verification

Spark Hire Intro Video

As part of the application process, you’ll be asked to complete a short Spark Hire intro video.

We’re particularly interested in hearing about:

  • Your B2B sales background and the types of solutions you’ve sold.
  • The typical deal sizes and sales cycles you’ve managed.
  • Your experience selling to C-suite and senior decision-makers.
  • Your approach to generating your own pipeline.
  • A complex or high-value deal you successfully closed.
  • Your quota attainment and sales performance.

Keep your responses clear, concise, and conversational. We want to understand how you communicate, sell, and approach complex B2B opportunities.

Completion of the Spark Hire intro video is required for your application to be considered.

Apply Now

If you:

  • Have 6+ years of B2B sales experience.
  • Have a proven record of hitting or exceeding quota.
  • Can build pipeline and close high-value opportunities.
  • Are confident selling to executives.
  • Thrive in complex, full-cycle sales environments.
  • Want direct ownership of revenue outcomes.

We’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and complete the required Spark Hire intro video to move forward in the hiring process.

jobs.excerpt: The Product Security Engineer is responsible for conducting comprehensive security assessments on various products, including mobile applications, IoT hardware/firmware, compiled software, and browser extensions.
jobs.description:
The Product Security Engineer is responsible for conducting comprehensive security assessments on various products, including mobile applications, IoT hardware/firmware, compiled software, and browser extensions. This role involves identifying vulnerabilities, developing mitigation strategies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to enhance security. The engineer will use both offensive and defensive security tactics to safeguard products and manage third-party risk. This role contributes to the organization's mission by safeguarding the supply chain and managing third-party risk.

Primary Accountabilities:

Technical (70%)

  • Conduct comprehensive security assessments of mobile applications, IoT hardware / firmware, compiled software and browser extensions.

  • Perform reverse engineering and vulnerability analysis, and penetration testing to uncover security risks.

  • Analyze binary file formats (PE, ELF, Mach-O) and runtime behaviors for security flaws.

  • Review browser extensions and software plugins for security flaws and compliance with best practices.

  • Perform product data analysis to identify potential vulnerabilities and determine access scope.

Operational (30%)

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g. - engineering, product, and security) to enhance security measures and improve resilience against cyber threats.

  • Develop and recommend mitigation strategies and risk profiles for identified vulnerabilities.

  • Document findings and communicate security recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Maintain organizational product inventory with security assessment status and secure configuration requirements.

  • Responsible for the production and maintenance of security documentation, such as bill of material repositories and analytical procedure guides.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelors of Science in a related field, such as Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Cyber Security

  • 5-7 years of relevant experience in software exploitation, reverse engineering, malware analysis, or related field; or any equivalent combination of experience and training that provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities needed to complete the primary job responsibilities

  • Proficient in using debuggers, decompilers, and disassemblers to analyze code for vulnerabilities across various CPU architectures, including ARM and RISC-V.

  • Strong understanding of binary file formats like PE, ELF, and Mach-O, enabling analysis of applications for security flaws

  • Skilled in low-level data extraction and analysis using tools like QEMU and Verilog to identify and verify vulnerabilities through emulation

  • Knowledgeable about Linux loaders, binary packing, and embedded systems tools such as BusyBox, binwalk, and u-boot

  • Experienced in capturing and analyzing network traffic, including using tools like tcpdump and Scapy to dissect proprietary protocols

  • Experienced in BOM enumeration and leveraging tools like CycloneDX for inventory and risk assessment.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for identifying and mitigating security risks.

  • Excellent communication skills for documenting findings, providing security recommendations, and effectively disclosing vulnerabilities to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience working in cybersecurity research or security assessment functions.

  • Experience with application security testing and associated static and dynamic analysis tools.

  • Knowledge of cryptographic principles and secure coding practices.

  • Familiarity with security assessment frameworks and compliance standards.

  • Prior experience with radio signals analysis and associated security hardening methodologies.

Individual Competencies:

  • Adaptable: Responds to change with a willingness to learn new ways to accomplish work objectives with a positive attitude.

  • Innovative: Ability to develop, sponsor, or support the introduction of new and improved methods, products, procedures or technologies.

  • Analytical and Critical Thinking: Ability to tackle a problem by using a logical, systematic, sequential approach.

  • Problem Solving: Gathers and analyzes information to generate and evaluate potential solutions to problems, issues and challenges while weighing the accuracy and relevance of the facts, data and information.

  • Communication: Giving and receiving messages and information in written, oral, and visual formats concisely for a complete understanding of meaning and intent.

  • Effective Execution: Gathers and analyzes information to generate and evaluate potential solutions to problems, issues and challenges while weighing the accuracy and relevance of the facts, data and information.

Role Title: Autodesk Inventor Specialist

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Autodesk Inventor Specialists to contribute to a customer-focused project involving advanced mechanical design.
